items.title: How the US midterm results could unfold - as millions of Americans head to the polls
items.summary: The BBC's North America correspondent considers three different scenarios, and what they would mean for the country.

items.title: Seven flights across Europe targeted by suspected bomb threats
items.summary: Planes in Poland, Spain, Bulgaria and Italy have been checked for explosives following separate threats.

items.title: King calls slave trade a 'shameful chapter' during Commonwealth address
items.summary: The speech comes after calls for the UK government to issue a formal apology for Britain's historic role in the trade.

items.title: Celebrity loses injunction bid but will stay anonymous pending appeal
items.summary: The unnamed man asked for an injunction to stop his identity being reported in connection with allegations against him.

items.title: Death toll rises in Ukraine after Russia attacks aid centre, hospice and hospital
items.summary: At least 38 people are killed in 24 hours and Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky warns dozens more could be trapped under rubble.

items.title: 'My necklace gave me a rash': Silver jewellery found to contain toxic chemicals
items.summary: An investigation by Watchdog analysed 25 items bought from Amazon, Etsy, Temu, eBay and OnBuy.

items.title: Binance says fake job interviews used as part of $6.3bn crypto hack
items.summary: An engineer was contacted through a legitimate job-hunting platform and invited to bogus job interviews with fake company representatives, Binance says.

items.title: Spanish footballer dies after collision with goalkeeper during match
items.summary: Tenerife striker Jesus de Miguel has died after the 30-year-old suffered a serious injury during a Spanish second-division match.
